o.norm: not necessary to close these resources

i.norm: Builds a stream backed by the given bytes, failing the test if the builder unexpectedly raises an I/O error (which it never should for an in-memory array).

Reading 1 byte into a zero-length destination array is an out-of-bounds request, so {@code read(dest, off, len)} must reject it with an {@link IndexOutOfBoundsException} regardless of how much data the stream actually holds.
The stream's own contents are irrelevant here; the range check on the destination array fails before any bytes are copied. These resources do not need to be closed.
